title: McLeodganj, Bir & Jibhi
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip; report at the pickup point 30 minutes early.
overview:
Three Himachal moods in one trip: this **4 Nights / 5 Days** group trip leaves Delhi every Friday evening in an AC push-back deluxe coach for an overnight journey to McLeodganj.

Day 1 covers Bhagsu Waterfall, Bhagsunag Temple and McLeodganj's market and Tibetan cafes. Day 2 moves to Bir for its cafes and a night camping under the stars. Day 3 is for paragliding at Bir Billing (own cost) before the drive to Jibhi. Day 4 drives to Jalori Pass for 360° views of the Great Himalayas and continues to Serolsar Lake. Day 5 treks to Choie Waterfall in Tirthan Valley and rides the Beas River rapids before the overnight journey back to Delhi. Stays, 8 meals, tolls and parking are included. Prices start at ₹15,000 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).
highlights: Bhagsu Waterfall, Bhagsunag Temple and McLeodganj's Tibetan cafes
A night camping under the stars at Bir
Jalori Pass, with 360° views of the Great Himalayas
Choie Waterfall trek in Tirthan Valley and Beas river rafting

itinerary.title: Departure from Delhi
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi, meet your team captain and the group.
Depart in the evening for the overnight journey to McLeodganj in an AC push-back deluxe coach.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: McLeodganj | Bhagsu Waterfall | Bhagsunag Temple
itinerary.content:
Arrive, have breakfast and take some leisure time.
Visit Bhagsu Waterfall and Bhagsunag Temple.
Spend the evening at the local market, chilling in cafes and trying Tibetan cuisine.
Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Bir | Camp night
itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and set off for Bir.
Explore the local market and cafes for some Tibetan cuisine.
Reach the campsite by evening for the sunset.
Dinner, a bonfire and a night camping under the stars.

itinerary.title: Bir Billing paragliding | Bir to Jibhi
itinerary.content:
Wake up early and get ready for paragliding at Bir Billing (own cost), then some leisure time in Bir.
Drive to Jibhi Valley, enjoying the sunset on the way.
Reach by late evening for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Jalori Pass | Serolsar Lake
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, drive to Jalori Pass and trek on for a 360° view of the Great Himalayas.
Continue to Serolsar Lake.
Back to the hotel for a bonfire and music, dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tirthan Valley | Choie Waterfall | Beas rafting | Departure
itinerary.content:
Wake up early for the sunrise, then breakfast and check out.
Head to Tirthan Valley and trek to Choie Waterfall.
Ride the rapids of the Beas River.
Depart for Delhi in the evening, reaching the next morning.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The trip leaves Delhi every Friday evening for an overnight journey to McLeodganj in an AC push-back deluxe coach. Pickup is from Delhi only. Final pickup details are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the McLeodganj, Bir & Jibhi trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹15,000 per person on quad sharing, ₹15,500 on triple sharing and ₹16,500 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

1 night in McLeodganj, 1 night in camps at Bir and 2 nights in Jibhi, 8 meals (4 breakfasts and 4 dinners), a deluxe push-back vehicle both ways, all transfers and sightseeing in the itinerary, a bonfire with music, and all toll taxes and parking.
No. Paragliding at Bir Billing is at your own cost, as are a 4x4 vehicle in snow and non-AC local vehicles.
Night 1 is in a hotel in McLeodganj, night 2 in camps at Bir, and nights 3 and 4 in Jibhi. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with a ₹3,000 advance per person (UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking) and pay the rest 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
The ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are no refunds for inclusions you don't use, and bookings can't be transferred.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, outdoor shoes, a daypack and personal medication. The full list is under Things To Pack.
